samples.prompt: Teachers should allow phones for carefully planned classroom activities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
requirementsVi: Nêu lập trường đồng ý.

Bàn tính khả thi, thừa nhận giới hạn và chốt lập trường.
samples.summaryVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that teachers should allow phones for carefully planned classroom activities raises a useful question about smartphones in the classroom. I agree with this view because it can meet a practical need. My support does not mean that every version of the proposal will work; the way it is introduced is also important.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng ý rõ, không khẳng định mọi cách làm đều tốt.

I agree with this view

parts.text: because it can meet a practical need. My support does not mean that every version of the proposal will work; the way it is introduced is also important.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — lợi ích
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that students can quickly access useful learning material. This is possible because a shared task can direct phone use towards a specific question rather than casual browsing. For example, a class can compare two digital maps to explain how a neighbourhood has changed. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — cách làm khả thi
paragraphs.text: A second reason for supporting this approach is that its difficulties can be addressed through practical changes. A practical response would be to agree on specific times for phone use and keep devices away during other tasks. For example, a teacher could allow phones for a five-minute research task and then ask students to put them in their bags. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.

In conclusion, I support the view that teachers should allow phones for carefully planned classroom activities. The main benefit is that students can quickly access useful learning material. paragraphs.text: The proposal that people should set clear limits on the time they spend on social media raises a useful question about social media use. It is true that an unrealistic rule may lead to arguments rather than better habits, especially because parents and children may disagree about when an online match can reasonably be stopped. This calls for better planning rather than the complete rejection of the idea.

In conclusion, I support the view that young people should balance gaming with other activities. The main benefit is that players can enjoy a hobby while still making time for other needs. However, careful planning and a response to practical difficulties are needed if that benefit is to be achieved.
